Title: An exported file is deleted from its export page
Step Action: Open Manage Contracts > Exports.
Click the export link of the row.
Step Expected: The export page opens with its list of files.

Step Action: Click Delete on the first file and confirm.
Wait for the page to load.
Check the page after the delete.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: An item is removed from a contract
Step Action: Open Manage Contracts > Customers and click Contracts on the first customer.
Click Contract Items on the first contract.
Click Remove on the first item.
Wait for the page to load.
Check the page after the remove.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: A viewer is removed from a participant
Step Action: Open Manage Contracts > Customers and click Participants on the first customer.
Click Viewers on the first participant.
Click <--Remove.
Wait for the page to load.
Check the page after the remove.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: An item is removed from a scheme
Step Action: Open Manage Schemes > Schemes.
Click Details on the first scheme.
Click the Tests tab.
Step Expected: The tests of the scheme are shown.

Step Action: Click the first visible Remove and confirm.
Step Expected: The item is removed from the scheme.

Step Action: Wait for the page to load.
Check the page after the remove.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.
